offering_description.value: Designs, installs and maintains electrical, lighting, data and communications systems for residential, commercial, industrial and infrastructure customers. Work is delivered mainly through contracting and service work, with some prefabricated assemblies built in company facilities.

primary_products.value: prefabricated electrical assemblies; lighting fixtures; control systems; wiring and cable materials

primary_services.value: electrical contracting; design-build services; maintenance and repair; low-voltage and communications installation; energy efficiency and solar installation

customer_segment.value: B2B: homebuilders, commercial developers, data center operators, industrial plant owners; B2G: municipalities and public agencies for infrastructure and utility work

end_markets.value: residential construction; commercial construction; data centers; industrial facilities; utilities and infrastructure

revenue_model.value: project or contract: construction contracts for electrical installation and systems work; service fees: maintenance, repair and service work for existing buildings and systems; product sales: prefabricated electrical assemblies and materials sold to projects
revenue_model.category: project or contract; service fees; product sales

value_chain_position.value: service provider: takes in project specifications and labor and materials, sells installed systems and services to owners and developers; OEM / manufacturer: fabricates prefabricated electrical assemblies from purchased components, sold to its own projects and customers

geography_served.value: US national: operates across most US states through regional offices and local branches

specialization.value: related lines: residential electrical, commercial and industrial electrical, infrastructure and utility work, communications and data center technology

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: bid and negotiated contracts with owners, developers and public agencies; own locations: regional offices and local branches across US markets

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: contractor and electrician licensing, building and electrical codes, and workplace safety rules from state licensing boards and OSHA
